description: Updates an existing marker's properties in the specified sequence. The sequence does not have to be the active one.

color.description: New colour. Marker colour — a name (green, red, purple, orange, yellow, white, blue, cyan) or an index 0-7. Defaults to green.

markerId.description: The ID of the marker to update

sequenceId.description: The sequence ID (GUID) as returned in the "id" field by list_sequences or get_active_sequence. Defaults to the active sequence.

name: update_marker
